runs.label: performance

runtime_modes: native; upstream startup preferences snapshotted and restored
native; lazy attach, auto launch disabled
native; connects to CAD only on tool invocation

runs.order_design: Seeded Williams/Latin square. Six systems and six repetitions balance every position and every within-row ordered adjacent pair once.
runs.fixture_design: Measured CAD document is closed before policy probes. Policies use a separate new block document; setup/cleanup and policy calls excluded from CAD timing.
runs.mass_query_validation: Call success only; returned mass/volume units were not separately asserted. Modeling-stage volume and bounds were checked by the independent oracle.
runs.timing_definition: Sum successful new_part, block, through_hole, parametric_edit, mass_query, step_export, close_own_document MCP timings; excludes policy probes and COM oracle time. Only fully passing seven-stage repetitions enter total speed statistics.

returned_mass_verification.scope: Derived volume check only; original timings/statuses and raw inputs remain unchanged; no inertia validation.
